DEFINITION · qeva:1:ordered-pair@1

Ordered pair

An ordered pair stores two objects while preserving which is first and which is second.

editorialset-theory · structure

PLAIN

The idea

An ordered pair stores two objects while preserving which is first and which is second.

EXACT

The compact statement

A pairing operation (a,b) must satisfy (a,b)=(c,d) iff a=c and b=d; one set encoding is {{a},{a,b}}.

EXAMPLE

(2,5) differs from (5,2) when 2≠5.

BOUNDARY / CAVEAT

The set encoding is one implementation; the structural property is what later constructions use.
